import numpy as np
def lib(x, name):
    out={}
    out[name+'1']=np.ones_like(x)
    out[name+'x']=x
    out[name+'x2']=x**2
    out[name+'sqrt']=np.sqrt(x)
    out[name+'inv']=1/x
    out[name+'log']=np.log(x)
    for c in [0.01,0.02,0.05,0.1,0.2,0.3,0.5,0.7,1,1.5,2,3]:
        out[f'{name}exp(-{c}x2)']=np.exp(-c*x**2)
        out[f'{name}exp(-{c}x)']=np.exp(-c*x)
        out[f'{name}exp(+{c}x)']=np.exp(c*x)
    for c in [0.2,0.5,0.8,1,1.3,1.6,2,2.5,3,4,5,6,8,10]:
        out[f'{name}sin({c}sqrtx)']=np.sin(c*np.sqrt(x))
        out[f'{name}cos({c}sqrtx)']=np.cos(c*np.sqrt(x))
        out[f'{name}sin({c}x)']=np.sin(c*x)
        out[f'{name}cos({c}x)']=np.cos(c*x)
    return out
